story_type: three fishermen in a life raft in heavy seas after their boat capsized, cutter crew throws a line
hook: Three fishermen in a raft, 40 miles out, in heavy seas.
narration: Three fishermen were in this raft, forty miles off Louisiana.
Their boat had capsized, and its emergency beacon went off.
A beacon sends the boat's position by satellite, so rescuers know where to look.
The cutter Yellowfin reached the raft in heavy seas.
A crewman threw a line, and it landed right on the raft.
outcome: All three fishermen were rescued, and no injuries were reported.
title: Raft in heavy seas, 40 miles out
description:
On Feb. 13, 2025, a fishing vessel capsized about 40 miles offshore from Caillou Bay, Louisiana. An aircrew found the life raft near the partially submerged boat, and the crew of Coast Guard Cutter Yellowfin rescued the three people aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Ryan Schultz, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/952526/coast-guard-rescues-three-mariners-40-miles-offshore-caillou-bay-louisiana
